value.rationale: Natural threshold-two successor-contact dynamics on K_{m,n} admits a complete, nontrivial labelled basin classification for all shore sizes. The sharp disappearance and reappearance of primitive three-cycles as a community grows 3→4→6 distinguishes this result from a routine oscillator count; asymptotic period-four and fixed-point rare-event scales make the classification mathematically informative. A finite exact quotient is a reusable method, not a substitute for the mathematical motivation.
